[Story]
Li Lei really likes a very famous band, this band plans to hold many concerts nationwide, but the ticket price is very expensive. He saves money for a long time, wants to save enough to go to the concert of his favorite band with his girlfriend. When his friend invites him to go, Li Lei says he does not want to go.

[Question]
Why does Li Lei refuse the invitation to the concert from his friend?

[Candidate Answers]
A. He does not have enough money to buy tickets.
B. The band is too famous and tickets are hard to get.
C. He already has other plans.
D. He prefers to watch with his girlfriend.
